page.title: Building Trust Since 1985
page.description: Star Asansör is a fully Turkish-owned company that has been manufacturing, installing and maintaining elevator and escalator systems since 1985.

story.title: A Passion for Engineering Since Day One
story.paragraph1: Founded in Ankara in 1985, Star Asansör has grown by putting customer satisfaction and the safety of life and property at the center of every decision. What started as a small workshop has become an engineering company serving all of Turkey and international markets from our Ankara and Istanbul offices.
story.paragraph2: From electric and hydraulic elevators to boutique projects requiring custom engineering, we take an end-to-end approach spanning manufacturing, installation, maintenance and modernization.

milestones.title: The Years We Set a First for the Industry
milestones.description: Every certificate we've earned and every step we've taken since 1985 is proof of our commitment to quality and safety.

items.1985: Star Asansör was founded in Ankara.
items.1988: Received Certificate of Compliance with Turkish Standards.
items.1996: Tested and put into service our first full-automatic elevator.
items.1998: Became the first company in Turkey to use a planetary gear motor group in elevators.
items.2001: Started insuring all elevators we maintain and their users, and made it a company principle.
items.2002: Started using remote-access elevator control systems for the first time.
items.2004: Obtained CE certification from LIFTINSTITUUT (95/16/EC Lift Directive Annex XIII Module H and TS-EN-ISO 9001:2000).
items.2005: Started using elevator multimedia systems for the first time.
